text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy, I
spot Mejiro
Dober deeply absorbed in a
book.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense... So adjusting one's
diet is the
best way to burn fat
efficiently...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! Don't just jump out at me like
that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-no, this is, uh... Yes, I am...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell anyone I was reading this,
okay?
Especially not Ryan and the
others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell anyone I was reading this,
okay?
Especially not Ryan and the
others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They'd probably all scramble to help me
if they
found out, but I don't want to
bother them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The thing is... I'm not sure I'll be able to
do this
right alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, come on! Do I have to say it
outright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So, um... If you have the time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Can you help me with this as part of my
training?
I think it'll be more effective
that way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to try following what this book
says, so...
could you help me out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We start working on Mejiro Dober's diet,
and it
seems to really help!
